name: tracework
description: Evidence-backed work reports and memory for agent sessions: generate reports now, capture key evidence, replay why, and roll work into reviews and roadmaps.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed work reports and memory for agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Generate daily, weekly, and monthly work reports from current evidence, capture key agent-session decisions and risks with dynamic depth, then reuse the record for recall, decision replay, reviews, and roadmaps.
defaultPrompt: Use Tracework to write a daily report with /tracework:daily.
Use Tracework to capture this key session with /tracework:capture.
Use Tracework to recall recent work context with /tracework:recall.
Use Tracework to query cited decision evidence with /tracework:query.
